title: Railway workers strike in Novara and surrounding areas

tea.why: Railway workers are protesting against current working conditions and wages, stating that previous contract agreements have not improved them.
tea.want: Improved working conditions, better wages, and enhanced safety standards in the railway sector.
tea.changed: Nov 23: The unions declared the strike concluded, stating that their demands remain unaddressed and they intend to continue their struggle.

summary: A 23-hour railway strike took place in Novara and the Verbano-Cusio-Ossola area, beginning on the evening of November 20 and concluding on November 21, 2026. Organised by the unions Cub Trasporti and Sgb Ferrovie, the action involved personnel from various railway companies. The strike caused significant disruptions, including train cancellations and delays, though minimum service levels were maintained during peak hours. The unions stated that the action was taken because working conditions and salaries have not improved despite previous contract signings. They further criticised corporate practices and called for continued efforts to secure better safety and professional recognition. Trenitalia and Trenord reported service modifications throughout the duration of the strike. The unions have indicated that they will continue to pursue their demands through future industrial action.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The strike concluded at 20:00, with ongoing service disruptions reported by Trenitalia and Trenord.
Unions issued a statement confirming the end of the strike and reiterating their commitment to future protests.
